D-dimer.caution: FEU and DDU are distinct reporting systems. Do not classify an unqualified D-dimer unit or convert FEU to DDU without assay validation.

PSA.caution: ABIM 2026 lists no single normal or abnormal PSA level. Interpret using age, prior results, screening context, and the reporting laboratory rather than a universal 4 ng/mL cutoff.

Vitamin_D.caution: The legacy 30-100 ng/mL interval comes from the superseded 2011 Endocrine Society guideline. The 2024 disease-prevention guideline does not endorse a universal serum target for healthy adults.

CD4_count.caution: Do not confuse absolute CD4 count with CD4 percentage.

Urea.caution: Urea and blood urea nitrogen (BUN) are different quantities and must not share an unqualified numeric range.

Troponin_T.caution: Do not apply this conventional-assay limit to high-sensitivity troponin T.

Troponin_I_hs.caution: Vendor assays have different 99th-percentile limits. Use the reporting laboratory limit when available.

Troponin_T_hs.caution: Vendor assays have different 99th-percentile limits. Use the reporting laboratory limit when available.

NT_proBNP.caution: These are diagnostic decision limits, not a single normal interval; age, renal function, and clinical setting are required.

hs_CRP.caution: Cardiovascular-risk categories are not interchangeable with the inflammatory CRP reference interval.

Gastrin.caution: Fasting status, proton-pump inhibitors, gastric acidity, and assay method affect interpretation.

CA_125.caution: A tumor-marker decision limit is not a cancer screening diagnosis and can be elevated in benign conditions.

CA_19_9.caution: A tumor-marker decision limit is not a cancer screening diagnosis and depends on method and clinical context.

CEA.caution: Smoking status, assay, and clinical purpose affect interpretation.

Beta_hCG.caution: Pregnancy and menopausal status are mandatory for interpretation; no universal adult interval is applied.

Ionized_calcium.caution: Do not compare ionized calcium with total calcium ranges.

Rheumatoid_factor.caution: The 24 IU/mL limit is for nephelometry; latex titers use a different reporting system.

ACTH.caution: Collection time and handling materially affect ACTH interpretation.

Interleukin_6.caution: No platform-independent reference interval; use the assay and reporting laboratory interval.

Interferon_gamma.caution: No platform-independent reference interval; use the assay and reporting laboratory interval.

Interleukin_8.caution: No platform-independent reference interval; use the assay and reporting laboratory interval.

TNF_alpha.caution: No platform-independent reference interval; use the assay and reporting laboratory interval.

Adenosine_deaminase.caution: Cutoffs depend on specimen (for example pleural, peritoneal, or CSF), method, and diagnostic purpose.

Anti_factor_Xa.caution: This is a therapeutic target for standard unfractionated heparin, not a normal population reference interval; drug and sampling time are required.

Beta_D_glucan.caution: Assays and positivity cutoffs differ; prefer the reporting laboratory interpretation.

Growth_hormone.caution: Growth hormone is pulsatile; provocative or suppression-test interpretation cannot use the resting interval.

CD8_count.caution: Do not confuse absolute CD8 count with CD8 percentage.

Urine_protein_24h.caution: Do not apply this interval to a random spot urine protein concentration.

Immunoglobulin_IgG4.caution: Elevated IgG4 is not diagnostic of IgG4-related disease and the interval is method-specific.

Ascites_cell_count.caution: Interpretation requires cell type (especially neutrophils), specimen context, and the reporting laboratory.

Amyloid_beta_40.caution: Reference values depend on specimen, platform, and whether a ratio is used.

CA_50.caution: Tumor-marker cutoffs are assay-specific; use the reporting laboratory interval.

EBV_DNA.caution: Viral-load results and clinical cutoffs are specimen- and assay-specific.

KL_6.caution: KL-6 decision limits are assay- and population-specific.

Soluble_CD25.caution: Units and reference limits vary substantially by assay.

Monoclonal_protein.caution: Interpretation depends on electrophoresis/immunofixation method and clinical context.

Digoxin_level.caution: Therapeutic interpretation requires indication, dose, renal function, and sampling time.

Iodine_serum.caution: Serum iodine is method- and exposure-dependent and is not interchangeable with urinary iodine.

Olanzapine_level.caution: Therapeutic drug monitoring is assay-, dose-, and sampling-time dependent.

Sirolimus_level.caution: Target trough varies by transplant type, regimen, time after transplant, and assay.

Tacrolimus_level.caution: Target trough varies by transplant type, regimen, time after transplant, and assay.

Valproate_level.caution: Therapeutic interpretation requires indication, albumin/free fraction, dose, and sampling time.

Total_bile_acids.caution: Reference and decision limits depend on fasting status, pregnancy, method, and clinical purpose.
